newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Mayr-Melnhof up 5 pct in bullish Vienna.
newsitem.headline: Mayr-Melnhof up 5 pct in bullish Vienna.

text.p: Shares of Austrian cartonboard maker Mayr-Melnhof surged more than five percent in midday trading in an overall bullish Vienna market, catching up with recent advances of the broader market.
"The market as a whole is quite bullish. Now the underperformers are being re-discovered," said one trader.

By 1015 GMT, Mayr-Melnhof was up 5.22 percent at 634.50 schillings, leading the day's advancers. The ATX index .ATX of 21 blue chips was up 0.76 percent at 1,319.05 points at the same time, down from a new intra-day high of 1,323.19 hit earlier in the day.
Over the past week, the ATX gained almost 2.8 percent, while shares of Mayr-Melnhof advanced 1.2 percent.

Traders said since the share had broken through key psychological resistance at 600 schillings it could easily continue its bull run for several more days, particularly as the market regarded the share as fundamentally well supported.
"Fundamentally, it's looking really good. There's a lot of optimism for next year," said one.
Mayr-Melnhof last month reported a nine percent drop in first-quarter operating profit but said it expected "good earnings" in the second quarter. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 53112 274
